data.title: SpaceX's AI spending unnerves Wall Street despite promises of quick payoff
data.description: In addressing Wall Street for the first time since SpaceX's IPO, executives tried to make the case that hefty AI investments are paying off within a year.
data.author: Ari Levy,Lora Kolodny
